eis_specs.document_title: Hargraves Bess — SSD source (v3.31.0 hybrid source-hunt)
eis_specs.notes: BESS 710 MW. Regime: SSD. Tilt Renewables / DevCo (development hold trust). Separate BESS-only project on Central-West Orana REZ Hargraves site, distinct from Energy Estate's Hargraves Energy Project. AEMO KCI N00237. No dedicated planning portal page located; likely still pre-EIS. Ark Energy also announced adding 2 GWh to nearby Bowmans Creek wind farm.
